name: Can I still pursue a case if I'm not sure medical negligence occurred?
description: Yes, you can consult a lawyer even if unsure about negligence; they will investigate to determine if medical malpractice occurred.

mainEntity.name: Can I still pursue a case if I'm not sure medical negligence occurred?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you suspect medical negligence or are unsure about the cause of your child's neonatal injury, it is still advisable to consult with a neonatal injury lawyer. Their role is to investigate the circumstances and determine if medical negligence played a role. They have the resources to review medical records and consult with experts who can provide an informed opinion. You don't need to be certain of negligence to seek legal advice; the lawyer will help assess the potential merits of your case.
